name: Create Agent
description: Create a new swarm agent (member) that can be delegated to or @mentioned.

function.name: create_agent
function.description: Create a new agent in the swarm. Use when the user asks for a new specialist (coder, netops, reviewer, …). The new agent joins multi-agent (swarm) sessions automatically. Prefer a clear name + role + short description. Optional workplace_id binds a local/tunnel/SSH workplace.

role.description: Short role tag (ops, research, coding, support, …).

id.description: Optional stable id (lowercase letters, numbers, underscore). Auto-slugged from name if omitted.

model_id.description: Optional LLM profile id (default profile if omitted).
